info.name: IA Booking API: test scenarios
info.description:
The twelve scenarios from docs/ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA_AND_TEST_SCENARIOS.md.

Start a fresh server with `npm run start:test` (15 second holds), then run the collection top to bottom, once. Restart the server before running it again.

Each request says in its Body tab what you can change. The checks follow what you typed.

item.name: Scenario 8: A waitlisted candidate gets a cancelled slot
item.description: Choose a visa type and advisor in 8.1. The scenario fills every such slot, puts a candidate on the waitlist, then frees one slot by cancelling.

item.name: 8.1 Joining the waitlist while slots are free

exec: pm.test("Refused: slots are still available, so book one instead (SLOTS_AVAILABLE)", () => pm.expect(code).to.eql('SLOTS_AVAILABLE'));

request.description: The waitlist is only for when nothing can be booked.

item.name: 8.2 Setup. Book every slot until none are left

// so that once every slot is booked, none comes free again by itself.
